title: Project create
responsibility: Creates a shared project from a repository offered by the connected GitHub account.

inputs.name: ProjectCreate.created
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the new project identifier after creation resolves. A synchronous callback exception is caught by the same failure handler as creation.

outputs.name: ProjectCreate
outputs.description: Loads GitHub configuration/connection and repositories on mount. Shows setup or connection guidance until usable, then repository and project-name fields. Name is trimmed and limited to 80 characters by the input; repository selection becomes a numeric ID. Blocks missing fields or concurrent saves, reports truncated lists and errors, and invokes created after success. Server remains responsible for checking repository administration.
